title: time: TestChan failures
body:
```
#!watchflakes
default <- pkg == "time" && test ~ `TestChan`
```

Issue created automatically to collect these failures.

Example ([log](https://build.golang.org/log/61494da7e528f2c5f1f762e1ea2882f83cc3f49b)):

    --- FAIL: TestChan (0.91s)
        --- FAIL: TestChan/asynctimerchan=1 (0.26s)
            --- FAIL: TestChan/asynctimerchan=1/Ticker (0.09s)
                tick_test.go:505: early done


— [watchflakes](https://go.dev/wiki/Watchflakes)
